title: Thai Coconut Pastry
description: A rich and creamy Thai dessert made with coconut cream, pastry, and a touch of spice.
instructions: Roll out the low-fat pastry and cut it into squares.
In a bowl, mix together the coconut cream, algerian cream, fat, sugar, vanilla extract, and salt.
Place a spoonful of the coconut cream mixture onto each pastry square.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastries with a little water and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake the pastries for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the pastries to cool for a few minutes before serving.
